subject: POC success metrics, owners, and weekly cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Reed <alyssa@noventis.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC success metrics & proposed cadence

Hi Alyssa — great to meet today. Thanks for walking us through the integration points and the three initial evaluation use cases (customer support search, knowledge summarization, and reranking). Per our call, I put together a compact plan so we can lock scope and owners before kickoff. Please see the high-level commitments below and confirm any changes.

Summary of proposed POC (3 weeks, dev + validation):
- Goal: Demonstrate 1) >= 85% F1 on retrieval+rerank for top-5 answers, 2) average generation latency <= 450ms at 95th percentile, 3) cost per 1k queries <= $X (TBD after initial telemetry).
- Scope: Staging-only data, sample of 5k queries, mobile + web channels.
- Success criteria (accept/reject gates): quantitative thresholds above + no critical data leakage issues on audit.

Owners / internal leads:
- Integration lead: Marcus Lin (marcus@redwood.com) — API integration & dataset ingestion
- Quality lead: Monica Patel (monica@redwood.com) — eval harness, metrics, and readout
- Account lead: Irene Choi — overall coordination and escalation

Timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (kickoff): May 5 — confirm test dataset slice, access, and accounts
- Week 1: integration smoke tests + baseline metric run
- Week 2: tuning and rerank experiments; mid-point readout
- Week 3: final readout and handoff; decisions for production path

Cadence: 30-minute weekly syncs (Thursdays at 9am PT) + asynchronous updates in the shared doc.

Attachments: I attached a lightweight POC checklist and a fillable PO template to simplify procurement info.

Next steps for Noventis:
1) Confirm sample dataset owner and delivery date (by EOD Fri Apr 30)
2) Confirm kickoff attendees and a preferred kickoff date (May 5 or May 6)
3) Share any compliance blockers or procurement timelines (esp. if SOC 2 evidence is required ahead of start)

Thanks — I’ll wait for your confirmation and will tentatively send a calendar invite for May 5 if that works.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC success metrics & proposed cadence

Thanks, Irene — this is helpful and aligns with how we think about success. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The priority is rerank precision for customer support (we'd weight that 50% of the success score), with summarization at 30% and latency/ops at 20%.
- For the dataset: we'll extract a 6k query slice from production logs (anonymized). Tom will own delivery — target May 3 EOD.
- Compliance: we'll need a short SOC 2 evidence packet before starting (appx 2 business days for our security review). I'll loop in procurement if any contract redlines are required.

Kickoff: May 5 at 10am PT works for most of our engineering stakeholders. Please include a 30-minute slot to walk the test harness and a follow-up 60-minute technical deep dive in week 1.

One ask: can you add an interim checkpoint metric for Week 1 (smoke baseline numbers) so we can see early signal and adjust?

If that looks fine I’ll confirm Tom as dataset owner and ping procurement.

Regards,
Alyssa Reed
Head of Product, Noventis
alyssa@noventis.com
